title: WorkerJobRequest
description: POST /jobs body. Commands are request/response; the durable job_id is minted by the Rust Core.

run_id.description: Present once a run context exists.

payload.description: Validated task parameters; never contains secrets or raw user content.

idempotency_key.description: Duplicate submissions with the same key return the existing job instead of re-executing.

checkpoint.description: Resume point for a retried or recovered job.
